source: proofs/lem-extcb-one-dimensional-product (af-validated, taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Level-one one-dimensional corner product: there are universal C_PQR < infinity and e_PQR > 0 such that, for e=delta+epsilon <= e_PQR, if Q is one-dimensional then abs(||X dot Y||-||X||||Y||) <= C_PQR*e*||X||||Y|| for X in S_{P,Q} and Y in S_{Q,R}.
